message.reasoning:
We need to produce JSON with cases array, coverage_map, open_questions. Must include 15-25 cases. Must cover each coverage area with at least one positive and at least one negative/boundary/security.

We need to design test cases for REST API.

Let's outline needed cases:

Coverage areas:
- auth token validation
- CRUD operations
- error handling (4xx/5xx)
- rate limiting
- schema validation

We need multiple cases per area.

IDs: API-001, API-002, etc sequential.

Each case fields: id, module (must be "api"), title (10-120 chars), coverage_area (one of list), type (positive, negative, boundary, security, non_functional), priority (P0,P1,P2), preconditions (array strings), test_data (object), steps (array strings), expected_results (array strings), automation_candidate (bool), notes (string).

We must ensure each case tests one behavior.

Let's design maybe 18 cases.

We'll need to include preconditions like resetting state, obtaining token, etc.

We need to reference test hooks: POST /_test/reset, POST /_test/clock, POST /_test/faults.

We need to include exact messages and error codes.

Let's list cases:

1. API-001: auth token validation positive: admin obtains token and uses it to GET /api/v1/test-cases. Expect 200 list.

2. API-002: auth token validation negative: missing token on GET test-cases. Expect 401 missing_token error code.

3. API-003: auth token validation negative: invalid token scheme. Expect 401 invalid_token.

4. API-004: auth token validation security: token tampered (modify one character) leads to 401 invalid_token (malformed token). Expect error code invalid_token.

5. API-005: CRUD operations positive: admin creates new test case via POST, then GET by id returns same data. Expect 201 creation and 200 get.

6. API-006: CRUD operations positive: admin updates test case title via PATCH, then GET shows updated title. Expect 200 patch and updated_at changed.

7. API-007: CRUD operations positive: admin deletes test case, then GET returns 404 not_found. Expect 204 delete and 404.

8. API-008: CRUD operations negative: viewer attempts to POST new test case, expect 403 forbidden.

9. API-009: CRUD operations negative: admin attempts to create test case with duplicate title (case-insensitive) expect 409 duplicate_title with message containing title.

10. API-010: error handling 404: GET unknown test case id 9999, expect 404 not_found with message "Test case 9999 not found".

11. API-011: error handling 405: POST to /api/v1/test-cases/1 (wrong method) expect 405 method_not_allowed.

12. API-012: error handling 422: POST test case with title exceeding 200 chars, expect 422 validation_error naming title.

13. API-013: error handling 500: enable DB fault, GET /api/v1/test-cases, expect 500 internal_error. Then reset fault and GET succeeds.

14. API-014: rate limiting positive: make 60 GET requests within same minute with valid token, all succeed 200.

15. API-015: rate limiting negative: 61st request returns 429 rate_limited with Retry-After header.

16. API-016: schema validation positive: GET a test case and verify response contains exactly fields id, title, module, priority, description, created_at, updated_at with correct types, no extra fields.

17. API-017: schema validation negative: maybe not needed because schema validation is about positive only? But need at least one positive case. Already have positive. Could also have boundary: token expires exactly at expiry time.

18. API-018: boundary: token expires exactly at exp time; advance clock to just before expiry, request succeeds; advance 1 second, request fails with token_expired.

That's token expiration boundary.

We also need boundary for pagination: page_size max 100.
